segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ שְׁנֵי גִיטִּין שֶׁכְּתָבָן זֶה בְּצַד זֶה, וּשְׁנַיִם עֵדִים עִבְרִים בָּאִים מִתַּחַת זֶה לְתַחַת זֶה, וּשְׁנַיִם עֵדִים יְוָנִים בָּאִים מִתַּחַת זֶה לְתַחַת זֶה – אֶת שֶׁהָעֵדִים הָרִאשׁוֹנִים נִקְרָאִין עִמּוֹ, כָּשֵׁר.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «two bills of divorce that» a scribe «wrote» on the same paper «one next to the other, and» the signatures of «two Hebrew witnesses,» i.e., witnesses who signed in Hebrew from right to left, «extend from underneath this» bill of divorce on the right «to underneath that» bill of divorce on the left, «and» the signatures of «two Greek witnesses,» i.e., who signed in Greek from left to right, «extend from underneath that» bill of divorce on the left «to underneath this» bill of divorce on the right, the bill of divorce «with which the» names of the «first» two «witnesses are read [nikra’in] is valid.» The other bill of divorce is invalid, as it is not considered signed by these witnesses.

segments.he: עֵד אֶחָד עִבְרִי וְעֵד אֶחָד יְוָנִי, וְעֵד אֶחָד עִבְרִי וְעֵד אֶחָד יְוָנִי, בָּאִין מִתַּחַת זֶה לְתַחַת זֶה – שְׁנֵיהֶם פְּסוּלִין.
segments.en: If «one witness» signed in «Hebrew» from right to left, «and one witness» signed beneath him in «Greek» from left to right, «and» underneath that signature «one witness» signed in «Hebrew, and» beneath him «one witness» signed in «Greek,» with the signatures «extending from underneath this» bill of divorce «to underneath that» bill of divorce, «both» bills of divorce «are invalid.»

moves.cueHe: שני גיטין שכתבן זה בצד זה
moves.summary: Two Hebrew and two Greek witnesses crossing: the get read with the first witnesses is valid.

moves.cueHe: עד אחד עברי ועד אחד יווני
moves.summary: Alternating Hebrew and Greek witnesses: both invalid.

positions.claim: the get with which the first witnesses are read is valid; interleaved Hebrew/Greek witnesses invalidate both
